app.name: Bihar STET CS
app.tagline: Master Computer Science for Bihar STET with bilingual learning

home.subtitle: Bilingual chapter notes with tables and diagrams, 700+ questions drawn from real STET shifts, strictly proctored mock tests that mirror the exam — and progress tracking on every chapter.
home.featuresTitle: Built around how the exam actually works
home.f1d: Every question, explanation and note in English and Hindi — switch anytime, even mid-exam.
home.f2d: Chapter-wise study notes with comparison tables, SVG diagrams and memory hooks.
home.f3d: Solved questions from actual Bihar STET 2023–24 shifts, cited with exam dates.
home.f4d: Topic-level and chapter-level quizzes with instant answer review.
home.f5d: Fullscreen CBT mode with question palette, timer and auto-submit on violations.
home.f6d: Accuracy, chapter completion at 70% and full attempt history on your profile.
home.s1d: Learn each chapter with structured tables, diagrams and exam tips.
home.s2d: Attempt topic, chapter or random mixes and review every explanation.
home.s3d: Simulate the real 150-question paper under monitored conditions.
home.s4d: Watch accuracy climb; chapters auto-complete at 70%.
home.ctaSubtitle: Create an account to save every attempt and track all 17 chapters.
